text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is over. The time we spent
there
wasn't without merit, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm left feeling a little forlorn. A certain

Umamusume who was always there with
us barely
showed her face at all.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tachyon, um...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nonetheless, we decide to touch on our
summer
camp experiences with Agnes
Tachyon.
Specifically those concerning
Manhattan Cafe's
friend.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm, I see... Well, whether it's witches or

something else entirely...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Who really knows what good and evil
are in the
first place? I'm of the opinion
that such notions
don't exist outside our
realm of existence.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Good and evil... don't exist? My friend is
neither?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes, it all boils down to direction.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Where do you want to go? Who do you
want to
take with you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Is good to the north and evil to the
south? Or is it
a matter of above and
below? And from which
angle are the
two determined?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good and evil do not exist, and even if
they did,
it wouldn't matter. Whatever
the intentions,
regardless of the course
taken...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If the results are good, you have your
answer.
Well, as long as your desired
destination aligns
with where your
friend's heading.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tachyon...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon's expression turns
suddenly stern.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And your destination is decidedly
different from
my own.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This summer, I came to understand
something...
and I came to a decision.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Cafe, Trainer. This is farewell. And
probably for
good.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let's dissolve our relationship. I won't
involve
myself with either of you
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Now don't make that face. This had to be done. We always were different, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was young. It took trying this out to
realize.
Well, I'd probably still disappear
from your lives
whether I realized or not.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The two of you and I... We're on
different paths.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon turns to leave without
showing a
hint of sorrow.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: See you around... someday...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Farewell for good. That's what she said,
and yet...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Manhattan Cafe, Agnes
Tachyon coolly
raises her hand.
